n01_intro

Getting a police character certificate in Pakistan usually means queues, paperwork and repeated visits to the police station. PakVerify moves the whole process online, with AI identity checks and a tamper-evident record.
n02_portals
Each user signs in to their own portal. Citizens, police staff, senior officers and administrators each get a separate dashboard, protected by a password and a one-time code.
n03_apply
A citizen submits a request and uploads their CNIC and photo.
n04_face
Live face verification asks the citizen to look straight, then turn left and right, so a printed photo cannot pass. ArcFace then matches the face with the CNIC record.
n05_police
The criminal record check runs automatically. Staff review the documents, and a senior officer approves the case.
n06_cert
After online payment, the certificate is issued with a QR code.
n07_chat_citizen
The built-in assistant is role-based. A citizen can track only their own application, and a criminal record lookup is refused.
n08_chat_staff
Signed in as police staff, the same assistant can search the criminal record dataset by CNIC. It is a rule-based assistant that answers only from the system's own records.
n09_admin
The administrator monitors the whole system from one control center: application totals, police staff accounts and service analytics.
n10_ledger
Every key action is written to a SHA-256 hash-chain ledger. The blockchain explorer re-checks every block, and when a stored record is altered, the chain is flagged as compromised.
n11_integrity
A certificate PDF is also checked against its issued hash. The original passes, while an edited copy is flagged as tampered.
n12_qr
Anyone can scan the QR code to open the public verification page, and the certificate hash is also anchored on the Ethereum Sepolia test network.
n13_tech
PakVerify is built with React, Django and PostgreSQL, ONNX face models and a Solidity smart contract, and it is deployed on Vercel.
n14_end
PakVerify. Faster, transparent and tamper-evident police verification. Thank you.
